title: Stop roaming where the Guru has already opened the crossing
summary: The shabad does not reward endless searching for its own sake. It names the deeper union as known through the True Guru, then gives the crossing its shape: devotion to the Lord and service to the Guru.
takeaway: Let devotion and Guru-seva end the search that keeps circling.
lifeApplication: When the mind asks for another method because obedience feels too plain, return to the practice already given. Complete one act of devotion or service before chasing another doorway.

source.shortMeaning: The deeper union is known through the True Guru and crossed by devotion to the Lord and service to the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: When wandering resumes, return to devotion and Guru-seva instead of treating novelty as depth.

evidence.coreClaim: The cited lines locate the deeper crossing in the True Guru, devotion, and service rather than in restless roaming.
evidence.turn: The search stops circling when the heart accepts the Guru-given crossing already in front of it.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind asks for another method because obedience feels too plain, return to the practice already given. Complete one act of devotion or service before chasing another doorway.
